notes_for_editor: Only source: the tnlandforms.us GA364 line and the page legend. Two searches returned no tower record. A Baldwin County Archives 'Goodloe Collection' object surfaced in search but returned HTTP 403 when opened, so it is not cited. The cached NHLR Georgia index and the cached firetower.org Georgia index list no Goodloe tower; a live fetch of the Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia page had no matching line. The list prints no elevation unit; 590 is read as feet, which matches the brief's 179.8 m. The story is short because the evidence is one line, below the 120-word floor, as with the Clinch example. Next step before expanding: a Baldwin County, Georgia Forestry Commission or local newspaper source. Budget: 3 page reads, 2 searches.
